# Synthetic Fixture Datasets

**These are NOT real Pennsylvania Insurance Department data.**

Generated for developer onboarding and integration testing on 2026-09-06.
All carrier names, rates, counts, and enrollee figures are invented and chosen
to exercise edge cases (formatting variants, negative rate changes, weighted
vs. unweighted rows, anomaly triggers). They carry NO relationship to actual
2026 approved rate filings.

Real data lives in data/ (gitignored where private) and must be sourced from
official PID filings. Do not copy fixture values into any report.
